seo.title: Website and digital platform design
seo.description: The studio frames, designs and builds websites and digital platforms. Two levels of engagement, both on show: a productised offer for shops and small businesses, and custom projects, quoted per brief. From Dakar.
seo.customTitle: Custom projects — websites, platforms and business portals
seo.customDescription: Corporate and bilingual websites, platforms, business portals, design systems and integrations. Quoted per brief: a written scope, delivered milestones, formal acceptance, maintenance and a documented exit.

hero.lede: Websites, platforms, local presence and automation. Two ways to work with us, of equal weight: a packaged offer for shops, and bespoke projects.
hero.ledeShort: Two ways to work with us, of equal weight: a pack for shops, or a bespoke project.

levels.title: Your project, at your scale.
levels.lede: One publishes its whole price list, the other shows no amount. Neither comes before the other.

shops.tag: Packaged tier · public price list excl. VAT
shops.cta: See the shops and small business offer
shops.title: Shops and small businesses
shops.body: Your Google profile, your page, WhatsApp Business, your photos: one pack, a displayed price, an instant online quote.
shops.bodyShort: Google profile, page, WhatsApp Business. One pack, a displayed price.

custom.title: Bespoke projects
custom.body: Platforms, institutional websites, digital products, AI automation. We qualify your need before talking budget.
custom.bodyShort: Platforms, institutional websites, automation. We qualify before talking budget.

services.title: Our services, [made to measure.]
services.s1Body: React, CMS, bilingual, accessible, fast on 3G.

method.s1Title: Understand your goals and your customers
method.s1Body: A qualification call, with no commitment.
method.s2Title: Define the scope and the quote
method.s2Body: A clear document: what's included, what isn't.
method.s3Body: Mock-ups approved before code, regular checkpoints, progress visible at any time.
method.s4Body: Your team is trained to keep what was built alive.

qualif.title: Describe your project.
qualif.lede: We don't publish bespoke prices: we ask you for a form of engagement, so we can answer accurately. Marketing leadership requests are passed on to MY ONOMA.
qualif.ledeShort: No public bespoke prices: a form of engagement helps us answer accurately.
qualif.next: The rest of the request (project type, timing, contact details) opens on the next page, with what you've already entered.

custom.lede: Every engagement starts from a problem, a scope and a calendar, and is written down before it is priced. The studio takes on five families of them, each named in turn with what it covers.
custom.truthTitle: Why there is no price on this page
custom.truthStart: Because none of these projects sells off a shelf: what gets priced is a written scope, never a hunch. If you want a public rate card and a posted price,
custom.truthStrong: the shops and small business offer
custom.truthEnd: is the one you want — it posts its prices, and it is built for exactly that.

items.title: Corporate and bilingual websites
items.body: Institutional sites, brand sites, event sites. Two languages served from a single back office, each with its own addresses.

items.title: Platforms
items.body: Business products, client areas, marketplaces, learning spaces. Accounts, roles, permissions, payment and dashboards.

items.title: Business portals
items.body: Internal tools, back offices, member or partner portals. What your team redoes by hand every week becomes a screen.

items.title: Design systems
items.body: Tokens, components, documentation and automated guardrails, so your interfaces stay coherent without depending on one person.

items.title: Integrations
items.body: Programming interfaces, links between the tools you already run, automation, and artificial intelligence plugged into a flow that already exists.

steps.lede: From the first conversation to the contract: four steps, and none of them commits you to the next. Nothing gets built before the scope is written, and nothing gets invoiced on a hunch.

items.title: A conversation
items.body: No commitment. We look at the problem together, at what already exists, and at whether the studio is the right party. If it is not, we say so there and then.

items.title: A written scope
items.body: The perimeter, the assumptions, the milestones, what is not included and what would take a change order. That document is what gets priced, and it stays yours even if the project does not happen.

items.title: A priced proposal
items.body: The written scope is priced exactly as it stands: what is included, what would take a change order, and how long the proposal holds. No line enters the price without appearing in the document.

items.title: A contract, then the start
items.body: The contract carries the scope over without rewriting it, sets the start date and names who speaks for each side. Design work begins from there.

delivery.lede: The part that proposals leave blank, and the part that decides what the rest is worth.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: A signed record per milestone, against the written scope.
points: Acceptance criteria are written at framing, not at acceptance time.
An acceptance address kept separate from production, open for the whole engagement.
Fixes raised during acceptance are not billed: they are part of the milestone.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.body: Settled before delivery, never improvised afterwards.
points: Corrective work, changes and security updates are told apart in writing.
A response time per severity level, stated in the contract.
No mandatory retainer: you can take it back in house whenever you decide to.

reversibility.title: Exit
reversibility.body: Leaving has to be possible without asking us first.
points: Repository, hosting and domain name in your name from day one.
Your data exports in an open format, with no action needed from us.
A handover manual lets another team pick the work up.

form.lede: A few questions to understand the need. If we are not the right party, we say so plainly.
form.engagementLabel: What shape of engagement do you have in mind?
form.engagementHint: We ask for a shape of engagement — a duration, a team — rather than a sum: no price is posted on this page, and none is asked of you.
form.descriptionLabel: The project in a few lines
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What you want to get, what already exists, and what is blocking you today.
form.replyEyebrow: So that we can answer you
form.reply: A written answer, within two working days.

engagements.exploring: Still open — we'd rather talk it through
engagements.small: A short piece of work, one scope
engagements.medium: A framed project, over a quarter
engagements.xlarge: A programme, with a dedicated team

errors.projectType: Pick a kind of project. It is what decides whether the request belongs with design or with the growth practice.
errors.engagement: Pick a shape of engagement. Without it we cannot tell you straight away whether we can work together.
errors.timeline: Give us a timeline, even a rough one. It is what says whether we can take the project on.
errors.description: The project in a few lines is what lets us answer with something other than a template proposal. Write them here.
errors.descriptionShort: Under {{min}} characters we cannot judge whether the project is for us. Add what you want to get, and by when.
errors.name: We need a name to answer. Yours will do.
errors.company: Tell us the name you work under: it is what tells us who we are talking to.
errors.email: Without an address your request arrives and stays unanswered. Add yours.
errors.emailInvalid: That address isn't shaped like an email. Check what comes before and after the @.
errors.sendFailed: It didn't go through and nothing was saved. Your request is still in the form: try again in a moment.

sent.lede: No automated sequence, no sales follow-up. A written answer, within two working days.
sent.growStart: Growth, acquisition and revenue are carried by
sent.growEnd: , the sister practice inside MY ONOMA. We pass your request on exactly as it is — you have nothing to redo, and nobody sends you back to another form.
sent.footer: No request is turned away. It is redirected.
